This mechanism is supported by the fact that pentostatin binds irreversibly to the active site of adenosine deaminase and forms covalent bonds with critical amino acid residues. The evidence path showing that pentostatin prevents inflammation associated with adenosine deaminase further supports its inhibitory action on the enzyme.
